plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Friend Radar uses your location to show which friends are near you.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow "Always" so Friend Radar can tell you when a friend comes near, even when the app is closed. Friends only ever see a rough distance, never your exact location.
